diagnostic.label: Integration diagnostic
diagnostic.title: Integration diagnostic.
diagnostic.intro: Before writing a line of code, we map which systems you have, how they talk today and where it will break. It's the only honest starting point for an integration.

rows.label: Scope
rows.value: A survey of the systems that don't talk today: current integration map, data flows and single points of failure. Typically 4 to 8 systems.

rows.label: Duration
rows.value: Two weeks from kickoff, with one survey session per critical system.

rows.label: Budget
rows.value: Fixed before we start, no surprise hours. If you move on to implementation, it's deducted from the project.

rows.label: Deliverable
rows.value: Technical document and presentation session: integration map, prioritized risks and a phased implementation plan with estimates.

rows.label: Testing
rows.value: Test cases per critical flow and acceptance criteria agreed in writing before coding.

rows.label: Maintenance plan
rows.value: Monitoring, alerts, API contract versioning and documented handover so your team can operate it.
